'''Frey Suun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He trained at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and dueled a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] at one point. He wielded a [[blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
Like [[Florg Nerfherder]], Frey Suun is a stand-in character in the game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']]. He is also seen elsewhere in the game, training with his lightsaber under the eye of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].
